objective: Five accepted successor versions (V1-V5); each must natively win all eight fixed matches against the immediately preceding accepted version. The user reduced the original ten-generation goal to five on 2026-11-04; the acceptance protocol is unchanged.

protocol.acceptance: 8 native wins, 0 losses, 0 unfinished, 0 native draws, 0 runtime errors; deterministic mechanics, focused/full regression, typechecks and build pass.
protocol.scopeLimit: Win rate only for this verified eight-game schedule; no claim of universal or stochastic 100% win rate.

attempts.title: 工程师运输起点／返程
attempts.change: Fix carrier planning start and return after real MCV deployment, then test the transported engineer capture-sale candidate against V0.

attempts.title: 等射程冷却拉距
attempts.change: Allow equal-range armor to restore safe firing distance only during its own known cooldown, retaining fire-animation/path/crossfire protections.

attempts.title: 就绪集火预留
attempts.change: Reserve immediate focus-fire damage only for own weapons ready within six ticks; cooling guns must not divert ready guns from a kill.

attempts.title: 统一提前第三矿车
attempts.change: Fund the third miner at two refineries and three tanks when the base is not under visible siege, preserving weaker openings and normal behavior.

attempts.title: 国别开局组合
attempts.change: National opening: close allied starts fund first War Factory and second refinery before barracks; Soviet third-miner timing is advanced without changing Soviet barracks priority.

attempts.title: 国别开局＋就绪集火
attempts.change: Keep the seven-win national opening; reserve focus-fire damage only for own weapons ready within six ticks.

attempts.title: 拦截遵守恢复门槛
attempts.change: Honor the existing outnumbered/power-deficit regrouping gate in the approaching-force interception branch, while retaining direct base defence.

attempts.title: 局部装甲支援
attempts.change: Prevent isolated leading tanks from approaching a locally superior observed armor line; keep in-range firing and let distant reinforcements join.

attempts.title: 射程内支援计数
attempts.change: Use the leading tank's actual own firing range instead of an eight-tile circle when counting nearby armored support.

attempts.title: 苏军首矿场先行
attempts.change: Build the first Soviet refinery before barracks, then retain the required barracks-to-War-Factory chain; keep the seven-win national opening without failed micro additions.

attempts.title: 第四矿车先于扩产
attempts.change: Fund a fourth miner before a second War Factory for both sides; preserve already-committed buildings and normal behavior. The initial Soviet-only proposal was not benchmarked because allied strategy was unchanged from V1.

attempts.title: 供给优先＋就绪集火
attempts.change: Add ready-volley focus-fire reservation to the income-capacity candidate; cooling own guns do not divert ready guns away from a kill.

attempts.title: 己方血量加权战力
attempts.change: Weight own field-army strength by its exact known remaining health instead of rating critically damaged tanks at full strength.

attempts.title: 空仓忙碌矿车转向宝石
attempts.change: Allow known-empty busy miners to select currently visible safe gems; do not interrupt loaded or unknown-cargo busy miners and bound busy redirection to one per 900 ticks.

attempts.title: 同轮宝石目标分散
attempts.change: Assign distinct visible gem tiles to eligible miners within one redirection cycle instead of sending them all to the same tile.

attempts.title: 基地周边未知区域侦察
attempts.change: Prioritize public unexplored sectors within 32 tiles of the own start once the existing brutal scouting missions are created, keeping scout counts and production priorities unchanged; pair with known-empty miner redirection.

attempts.title: 侦察纯移动
attempts.change: Use direct Move rather than AttackMove for brutal scout travel, while normal scouts retain their existing orders and all scout budgets remain unchanged.

attempts.title: 六坦克成形再远征
attempts.change: Raise short/medium-map blind assault and non-base interception formation from four to six tanks while preserving direct base defence and close-range or late opportunity exceptions.

attempts.title: 成形与矿业供给配套
attempts.change: Pair six-tank reserve formation with fourth-miner funding before new dual-factory capacity, while preserving committed buildings, visible-invasion tank priority and normal production; check resource visibility before reading quantities.

attempts.title: 成形供给＋就绪集火
attempts.change: Apply the existing ready-volley focus-fire fix to the formation/income combination; do not reserve immediate damage from cooling own guns.

attempts.title: 恢复主力后扩矿场
attempts.change: Rebuild at least six own core tanks before starting further refineries beyond the opening pair; preserve committed investments, miner coverage, refinery caps and normal strategy.

attempts.title: 重工后提前第二矿场
attempts.change: Allow the funded second refinery to provide its miner after the own first factory exists without waiting for the first tank; retain funding, genuine free-unit, intrusion and normal-strategy conditions.

attempts.title: 已见本地宝石开局适应
attempts.change: Adapt the supplied armed-miner opening using currently visible local gems: finish a first tank when local gems are known, otherwise keep the funded early second refinery; chrono-miner opening unchanged.

attempts.title: 混编空军不绕过地面恢复
attempts.change: In a mixed army, air support no longer bypasses the ground assault formation or outnumbered recovery checks; preserve pure-air assaults and formed combined-arms opportunities.

attempts.title: 已见外围压力暂缓第四矿车
attempts.change: Before six own core tanks, postpone the early fourth-miner investment if a currently visible combat vehicle is within the existing 48-tile base approach perimeter. Preserve third-miner timing, unpressured fourth-miner investment, formed reserves and normal production.

attempts.title: 六装甲前暂缓高级科技
attempts.change: Do not start advanced NATECH/GATECH before six own core armor units; keep the existing committed-tech and refinery/harvester logic without reordering it.

attempts.title: 先射击射程内未覆盖装甲
attempts.change: When unreserved enemy armor is inside a core tank's actual current-stance range, exclude unsuitable combat-vehicle alternatives while preserving non-armor target scores, bursts, minimum range, overkill avoidance and other weapon roles.

attempts.title: 矿场朝已见安全宝石布置
attempts.change: For brutal only, align refinery placement with the existing safe-visible-gem miner preference: favor eligible gem tiles within 32 tiles of own construction yards and outside 14 tiles of observed combatants or armed structures; retain original resource and placement fallback otherwise.

attempts.title: 足额预算六装甲后扩第二重工
attempts.change: Allow new dual-factory capacity with three miners and two refineries only once six own core armor units exist and credits cover the actual factory cost plus 400; keep the original four-miner and committed-factory paths.

attempts.title: 只在远征等待局部装甲支援
attempts.change: Apply local tank support readiness only during nondefensive assaults: an out-of-range isolated leader waits for nearby armor, while in-range fire, defensive response and distant reinforcement advance stay active.

attempts.title: 矿车型别选址＋苏军八装甲开局
attempts.change: Keep gem-facing refinery placement only for genuine CMIN-supplying refineries; HARV returns to V2 placement. For brutal Soviet non-close short/medium openings, require eight own core tanks before new strategic assaults and external reserve interceptions; retain normal, known-close, long-map, late and direct base-defence behavior.

attempts.title: 苏军库存门槛覆盖早期恢复
attempts.change: Extend the existing Soviet eight-core non-close assault/reserve-interception gate through 12000 ticks instead of expiring at the generic 10000-tick late-game boundary; keep eight-core readiness and all other exceptions unchanged.

attempts.title: 首重工已见宝石决定恢复节奏
attempts.change: Choose Soviet reserve expiry from own visible local gems when the first own factory and a miner are present: remember that opening observation, using 12000 ticks for gem-backed openings and 10000 otherwise. Preserve eight-core readiness, all exceptions and miner-specific placement; no seed or player-slot branch.

attempts.title: 受保护就绪直接攻击纳入预留
attempts.change: During a protected firing sequence, reserve only known ready single-shot damage for a still-visible in-range target of the own last direct Attack order. Do not infer AttackMove targets, unknown impact, remaining burst subshots, cooling or minimum-range-invalid fire; preserve animation protection and normal behavior.

attempts.title: 新高级科技等待八装甲
attempts.change: Raise only the noncommitted advanced NATECH/GATECH core-armor gate from six to eight; keep committed technology, miner prerequisites and all V3 strategy/micro unchanged. Failed T034 reservation is excluded.

attempts.title: 少量矿石货舱补已见宝石
attempts.change: Allow only known quarter-load ore/no-gem miners that are busy, stationary on a visible ore tile, not firing and more than six tiles from all own refineries to redirect to the existing safe visible reachable gem targets. Preserve full/unknown/moving/idle cargo protections, 900-tick busy cadence and all V3 macro/micro; no engine harvesting or capacity changes.

attempts.title: 连续增矿观测后补宝石
attempts.change: Use two consecutive own cargo observations 30 ticks apart, with ore increasing on the same tile, as recent-harvesting evidence for quarter-load gem top-up. Remove T036's blanket refinery-distance exclusion; keep known cargo/capacity, stationary visible-ore, no-fire, original safe reachable gem targets and busy 900-tick cadence. V3 base only.

attempts.title: 近期增矿低载量使用短改道间隔
attempts.change: For quarter-load miners with consecutive owned ore-growth observations, use the existing 90-tick gem retry minimum instead of the generic 900-tick busy cadence. Keep stationary/known-cargo/no-fire/visible-ore checks and original visible safe reachable gem selection; other busy miners retain 900 ticks.

attempts.title: 内圈部分未知区域优先侦察
attempts.change: Append one higher-priority 24-tile inner-local unknown-sector scan to the existing brutal initial 32-tile scan. Keep original visibility cutoff, public coordinates, scout counts/budgets, normal behavior and all V3 economics/combat unchanged.

attempts.title: 限时完成当前本地侦察目标
attempts.change: After the original 3600-tick cutoff, let a living brutal scout finish its current nonpermanent unknown target inside 32 tiles, at most through 5399 ticks. Preserve normal/far/permanent/visible/no-target/dead-scout exits and original unit budget/travel/timeout behavior.

attempts.title: 射程内目标计入己方转炮等待
attempts.change: For known core tank turrets scoring in-range combat vehicles, subtract bounded estimated turning delay beyond the own remaining cooldown. Use own turret facing/public rotation rates and observed target coordinates, preserving firing protection and native weapons/turning/damage.

attempts.title: 矿车交付采用已见重工出口寻路
attempts.change: For known empty harvesters already moving along a matched own factory delivery row, validate gem reachability from the observed native +rx exit when the interior tile is blocked. Preserve stationary deployment, ownership/delivery-ID checks, exit visibility/passability, original cargo/cadence/safety and V3 policy; no generic API or delivery-task changes.

attempts.title: 分配时跳过已见侦察队列点
attempts.change: At brutal scout target allocation, consume queued public coordinates that are already visible before assigning an unknown point. Keep normal allocation, original manager expansion/head cleanup, unit budgets/lifetimes and all V3 economics/combat unchanged.

attempts.title: 第五矿车先于新扩产及高级科技
attempts.change: Behind eight core tanks and an actual miner-cost-plus-400 cash buffer, prioritize a fifth miner. Require five miners before new second-factory or advanced-tech investments while preserving committed structures and all other V3 production/strategy logic.

attempts.title: CMIN 宝石开局与矿车型别投资
attempts.change: Retest T044's HARV income gate while pure owned CMIN income permits new factory/tech investment at four miners. A two-miner CMIN opening with currently visible gems within 32 tiles can fund the third miner after three core tanks; preserve ordinary ore/hidden/distant/normal behavior and all other T044 components.

attempts.title: 第四 CMIN 等六装甲成形
attempts.change: Require six core tanks for fourth-CMIN investment and use existing priority 78 at six/seven tanks, preserving explicit higher requests and the original eight-core priority. HARV investment, T045 gem opening and miner-specific factory/tech gates remain.

attempts.title: 保留已排队第四 CMIN 投资
attempts.change: Retain an already queued fourth CMIN with a 45 priority floor outside visible direct siege, with two refineries and observed resources. New fourth-CMIN requests still wait for six core tanks; preserve the original 2x cancellation rule, effective 100-priority emergencies, HARV production and T046 policy.

attempts.title: 第四 CMIN 等八装甲成形
attempts.change: Delay fourth-CMIN investment from six to eight core tanks, retaining original priority 70 at eight and explicit higher requests. Preserve HARV investment and the T046 bundle; failed T047 queued-miner retention is excluded.

attempts.title: 第四 CMIN 等七装甲成形
attempts.change: Test the intermediate seven-core fourth-CMIN investment window. Preserve original priority 78 at seven, 70 at eight, explicit higher requests, HARV and the T046 bundle. Failed T047 retention is excluded.

attempts.title: 已见空中压力时优先盟军原生 FV
attempts.change: Enable the existing bounded visible-air response for an available allied FV, choosing/counting the native AA type. Preserve Soviet HTK, priority 100, the 2-to-6 target, 600-tick memory, normal behavior and the T046 bundle; exclude failed T047-T049 changes.

attempts.title: 护送后侧点越界时回退己方实际位置
attempts.change: Repair the escort point generator exposed by T050: when the computed rear tile is missing/nonplayable, use the owned escort unit's actual tile. Retain valid rear offsets, normal behavior, existing action API validation and the T050 bundle; no engine or general API changes.

attempts.title: 盟军最低防空目标为一辆 FV
attempts.change: Reduce the available allied FV air-response minimum from two to one, preserving ceil(visible aircraft/2), cap six, priority 100 and 600-tick memory. Keep Soviet minimum two, the corrected escort boundary and the T051 bundle; native costs/weapons and normal behavior are unchanged.

attempts.title: 开局新雷达等待八装甲至 10000 tick
attempts.change: Before tick 10000 at ground-first public starts, defer new AMRADR/GAAIRC/NARADR until eight own core tanks. Preserve committed requests, distant air openings, late fallback and all V4 components. The fresh fixed schedule must use frozen V4 as opponent.

attempts.title: 己方残余血量的有下限战力权重
attempts.change: Test bounded own-health power weights: known own units retain 50% nominal power plus 50% times remaining-health fraction. Preserve normal/unknown-health fallback, force/armor thresholds and all V4 components; exclude failed T053 radar gating.

attempts.title: 四分之三战力下限与 1.25 主装甲出击比
attempts.change: Retest force evaluation with a 75% nominal own-power floor plus 25% remaining-health contribution and a brutal major-armor assault ratio of 1.25. Preserve normal, direct defense, existing late/air exceptions, armor counts and V4 policy; exclude failed radar gating.

attempts.title: 冷却恢复期保留仍可接战的直接目标
attempts.change: Keep a core tank's last observed in-range direct target during explicit known single-shot cooldown recovery, unless already covered by immediate volley reservation. Preserve lost/invalid/minimum-range targets, initial/burst protection, support roles, normal and all frozen V4 policies; exclude T053-T055 components.

attempts.title: 仅受损旧目标保留冷却期稳定性
attempts.change: Retest T056 cooldown stability only for observed wounded direct targets at no more than half apparent HP. Healthy/unknown-health targets retain original scoring; recovery, visibility, min/max range, immediate volley and firing protection remain. Normal and frozen V4 economic/assault policies are unchanged.

attempts.title: 第三／第四矿车前保留五／八核心装甲
attempts.change: From frozen V4, reserve five core tanks before a third miner (preserving six-core single-refinery fallback), and eight before a fourth HARV/CMIN. Preserve observed-resource/siege gates, fifth-miner budget, refinery-supplied miner dedup, cancellation and normal behavior; exclude failed T053-T057 tactics.

attempts.title: 明确冷却中的忙碌坦克保持原订单
attempts.change: After existing emergency escapes/retreat and unless holding an injured reserve, retain busy core tanks' ongoing orders in explicit CheckRange/PrepareToFire with known primary cooldown over six ticks and isFiring false. Do not infer native target IDs. Preserve idle/recovered/unknown/support/normal behavior and all frozen V4 policy.

attempts.title: HTNK 稳定冷却与主队已见防空避让
attempts.change: Retest T059 busy cooldown continuity only for HTNK in PrepareToFire, restoring allied tanks and CheckRange, and enable existing visible-AA air safety for brutal field armies. Preserve normal distance-dependent safety, original emergency/reserve paths, V4 economy, assault policy, native costs/weapons and observation boundaries.

attempts.title: 基础装甲射程外采用安全原生 AttackMove
attempts.change: From frozen V4, use the original safe coordinate AttackMove helper for movable ordinary MTNK/HTNK approaching a visible target beyond weapon range, with the existing strategic point. Keep in-range direct volleys, critical/unknown own health, immobile/prevented moves, support/siege/normal and original safety paths unchanged.

attempts.title: 在 V4 复测矿车出厂可见出口寻路起点
attempts.change: Retest exact T042 matched-owned-factory native-exit gem-path origin on frozen V4. Preserve real unit position/delivery, cargo/timing/visibility and V4 macro/micro; require fresh same-source native delivery observation plus a new eight-game run against V4.

attempts.title: 真实维修厂预算与原生付费装甲恢复
attempts.change: From frozen V4, fund native repair depots for two-core damaged armies with real cost plus 400 reserve; send nearby damaged core armor to own ready depots outside visible weapon coverage and on safe routes, retaining valid Dock intent to full native paid recovery. Normal, costs/HP/rules/API and prior emergency micro are unchanged; require same-source repair/payment observation and new eight-game wins.

scopeLimit: Win rate only for this verified eight-game schedule; no claim of universal or stochastic 100% win rate.
